stories.title: Schengen, l'Italia proroga di 15 giorni il blocco con la Spagna. Madrid: "Inutile e vergognoso"

en.title: Schengen, Italy extends 15-day border block with Spain. Madrid: "Useless and shameful"
en.summary: Italy extended its suspension of border-free travel with Spain by 15 days. In response, Spain prolonged controls on travelers from Italy at ports and airports until October 8.

stories.title: Media, Madrid proroga fino all'8 ottobre i controlli su viaggiatori dall'Italia

en.title: Media, Madrid extends controls on travelers from Italy until October 8
en.summary: Spain extended border controls on travelers arriving from Italy in response to Italy's extension of Schengen suspension restrictions.

stories.title: L’Italia proroga di altri 15 giorni lo stop a Schengen con la Spagna. E Sanchez fa lo stesso

en.title: Italy extends 15-day Schengen stop with Spain. And Sanchez does the same
en.summary: Italy prolonged its Schengen suspension with Spain by another 15 days citing possible terrorism infiltration risks, with Spain implementing reciprocal measures.

stories.title: Lo "Stabilicum" passa al Senato, ecco cosa prevede la legge elettorale che ora torna alla Camera

en.title: The "Stabilicum" passes the Senate, here's what the new electoral law provides as it returns to the Chamber
en.summary: An electoral law passed the Senate requiring non-parliamentary parties to collect quadruple the number of signatures to run in elections, while established parties gain exemptions.

stories.title: L'Italia proroga di altri 15 giorni il blocco di Schengen con la Spagna. E Madrid fa altrettanto

en.title: Italy extends Schengen border block with Spain for another 15 days. Madrid does the same
en.summary: Italy has prolonged its suspension of the Schengen agreement with Spain for an additional 15 days due to internal security concerns, with Spain reciprocating the measure.

stories.title: Caccia italiani neutralizzano drone sopra la Lituania, razzi di segnalazione russi sfiorano aereo danese: il Baltico sull’orlo dell’incidente

en.title: Italian fighter jets neutralize drone over Lithuania, Russian flares nearly strike Danish aircraft: Baltic on brink of incident
en.summary: Tensions remain high on NATO's eastern flank as Italian fighters intercept a drone over Lithuania while Russian flares approach a Danish aircraft, raising concerns about potential escalation.

stories.title: Cosa prevede la nuova legge elettorale: preferenze, firme, soglia, tutti i punti della riforma

en.title: What the new electoral law provides: preferences, signatures, threshold, all points of the reform
en.summary: A new electoral reform bill returns to parliament for final approval, with provisions covering voter preferences, candidate signatures, and electoral thresholds under debate.

stories.title: Preferenze, soglia di sbarramento, premio e firme: cosa prevede la nuova legge elettorale

en.title: Preferences, electoral threshold, bonus, and signatures: what the new electoral law provides
en.summary: The new electoral law establishes that a coalition receiving at least 42 percent of votes in both parliamentary chambers gains additional seats, with gender alternation requirements starting from the second candidate.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, sì del Senato tra le polemiche: preferenze e soglia per il premio, ora alla Camera

en.title: Electoral Law, Senate approves amid controversy: preferences and threshold for bonus, now to Chamber
en.summary: The Italian Senate approved an electoral law bill with 113 votes in favor, 71 against, and 2 abstentions. The measure now moves to the Chamber of Deputies for further consideration.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, ok dal Senato tra le polemiche. Cartelli delle opposizioni in aula: “Una truffa”

en.title: Electoral Law, Senate approval amid controversy. Opposition banners in chamber: "A fraud"
en.summary: The Senate passed an electoral law reform with 113 affirmative votes. The bill will now return to the Chamber of Deputies for its third reading.

stories.title: Trovato il corpo di Gabriella Querino, la donna dispersa nella Laguna di Venezia

en.title: Body of Gabriella Querino found, woman missing in Venice Lagoon
en.summary: The body of 26-year-old Gabriella Querino was discovered in the water near Campalto this morning. She had been missing since Saturday morning.

stories.title: Pressioni su Lotito per vendere la Lazio. Coinvolto anche Bisignani

en.title: Pressure on Lotito to sell Lazio. Bisignani also involved
en.summary: Executives of a bank were subject to searches as part of a Rome prosecutor's investigation into alleged market manipulation involving pressure regarding a sports club sale.

stories.title: David Khougazian nuovo amministratore delegato di Chiesi

en.title: David Khougazian new chief executive officer of Chiesi
en.summary: David Khougazian will become the new CEO of the Parma-based group starting October 15, replacing Jean-Marc Bellemin who will continue as CFO.

stories.title: Salone di Genova, sale la presenza di grandi barche fino a 50 metri

en.title: Genoa Boat Show, presence of large yachts up to 50 meters increases
en.summary: The 2026 Genoa International Boat Show will feature increased numbers of large yachts in the 35 to 50 meter range, with overall participation rising by 14.1% compared to 2025.

stories.title: Spaggiari rileva Esds per crescere in America Latina e Penisola Iberica

en.title: Spaggiari acquires Esds to grow in Latin America and Iberian Peninsula
en.summary: Spaggiari, a platform company owned by Ambienta, is acquiring Esds to expand its operations beyond Italy into Latin America and the Iberian Peninsula.

stories.title: Welfare integrativo applicato dal 46% delle imprese liguri

en.title: Supplementary welfare adopted by 46% of Ligurian companies
en.summary: Nearly half of businesses in Liguria have introduced supplementary welfare initiatives beyond national collective agreements, with most planning to maintain or expand these programs.

stories.title: Terzo valico, via libera a 58 milioni per rigenerare tre quartieri a Genova

en.title: Terzo Valico project: €58 million approved for regenerating three Genoa neighborhoods
en.summary: Funding of 58.6 million euros has been approved for urban regeneration of three Genoa districts affected by the Terzo Valico railway project.
